Space Operations Computing - Software Engineer (Entry Level)
Job Locations
US-TX-Houston
Job ID 2026-2877 Category Software Engineering
Overview

Barrios Technology is an engineering solutions partner with more than 45 years of experience supporting NASA and the commercial space industry. We deliver innovative engineering, software, and technology integration services across NASA centers nationwide. Barrios prides itself on a people-focused culture that values creativity, diversity, professional growth, and a healthy work–life balance.

 

We have an excellent opportunity to serve as a Software Developer on the Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Avionics and Software Computer Resources team. This team develops software and the underlying IT platforms that supports the International Space Station. The position includes software design, implementation, testing, user support, and maintenance of systems developed under the Integrated Mission Operations Contract III (IMOC) Contract. 

Responsibilities

The Space Operations Computing - Software Engineer will:

Collaborate with System Engineers, System Testers, Software Developers, and the user community.
Perform software design, implementation, testing, and provide user support after release.
Interface with customers and provide support to the user community as required.
Approach unfamiliar technical tasks with initiative and curiosity using research, experimentation, asking questions, and iterative learning to determine effective solutions.
Work effectively both independently and as part of a dynamic team environment.
Support Apple device management tasks including configuration, enrollment, compliance, and troubleshooting for managed iOS, iPadOS, and macOS devices.
Assist with virtualization technologies as part of ISS platform infrastructure.
Contribute to automation and configuration management using Ansible for systems and platform components.
Qualifications

Required Education/Experience/Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related field, plus zero (0) to five (5) years of experience.
Experience with a subset of the following technologies: C/C++/C#, Java, JavaScript, Unix/Linux, Windows, web development, Apple device management solutions (such as Jamf) and supervised Apple devices, virtualization technologies, and Ansible for automation and configuration management.
Ability to learn quickly when facing new or non-traditional technical challenges.
Excellent oral and written communication skills for customer and team interactions.
Strong initiative, teamwork, and critical thinking abilities.

Essential Requirements 

Must be a U.S. Citizen and successfully complete a U.S. government background investigation.
Applicant selected may be subject to government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
Work may involve sitting for extended periods.
May require lifting and carrying up to 25 lb.
Must have sufficient mobility to enter areas of test facilities where necessary.
Generally, an office environment but can involve inside or outside work depending on task.
Standard office equipment (PC, telephone, fax, etc.)
Regular attendance in accordance with established work schedule is critical.
Ability to work outside normal schedule and adjust schedule to meet peak periods and surge requirements when required.
Must be able to work in a team atmosphere.
Must put forward a professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation.
Grooming and dress must be appropriate for the position and must not impose a safety risk/hazard to the employee or others.
This position may require some commuting and traveling to other installations as needed.

 Don’t miss out on this great opportunity; for immediate consideration, apply now!

 

Barrios Technology is a drug-free workplace, which is imperative to the health and safety of all employees and is required as a condition of receiving contracts from federal agencies. Please remember that regardless of the legalization of marijuana in several states, possession and use continues to be illegal under the federal Controlled Substances Act. This includes the use of some CBD products. A post-offer, pre-employment drug test is a condition of employment.

 

Barrios Technology is an Equal Employment Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
